A cart's WebGPU handles are its own heap allocations, so the view of a shadow map remade at the new preset's size came back at the old view's address and three.c's bind-group cache (keyed by the view) kept sampling the old map: shadows of flags and rocks from where the rider had been, rocks' own shadows gone (0.7% of the frame here; 0 after the fix, 0.01% native WebGPU vs GL). Native WebGPU holds the old view alive in the cached group, so only the carts showed it.
